I like this Moto G5 Plus. I like this Moto G5 Plus. It is a whole lot faster than my last phone. I got a Sim card from my provider and had it up and running in less than 10 minutes.

Size and dimensions. The Moto G5 Plus has a nice balance of size and shape. It has a large screen but is not too large to hold in your hand. Wi-Fi connectivity. The Moto G5 Plus does a good job connecting and staying connected to the Wi-Fi networks at my home and office. I also can easily set it up as a hotspot and my devices connect to it via Wi-Fi and it provides a strong, wide reaching signal. Fingerprint Sensor. I had low expectations for this at the start, but the fingerprint sensor works well and is not too touchy. All it takes is basically the same pressing motion you would have to turn on an iPhone, but with the added security of the fingerprint sensor built in. Cons: It really is not a particularly good phone.

Mainly for more storage space (8G-32G), more battery life and faster charging. Also my old Moto G would act up every now and then and be so frustrating. #1) On battery life I usually watch a few videos at lunch and read Google News at breaks. send a few text and use the phone a little and after 8 1/2 hours the phone would have 20% battery left or would go completely dead.With the new 5th generation Moto G at the end of the day it has 64% battery life.
